description: This file defines the DefaultValueBinder class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for binding values to spreadsheet cells with proper type detection and handling various data types including strings, numbers, booleans, dates, and formulas.

classes.name: DefaultValueBinder
classes.description: Class responsible for binding values to spreadsheet cells, determining their data type, and formatting them accordingly.

methods.name: bindValue
methods.description: Binds a given value to a cell, sanitizing strings and converting objects like DateTime and RichText to appropriate formats before setting the value explicitly.

methods.name: dataTypeForValue
methods.description: Determines the appropriate data type for a given value, including handling nulls, numeric values, booleans, strings, formulas, and errors.
